description: Start a new asynchronous coding task with Jules. Provide a detailed task description and the repository to work on. Jules runs in an isolated cloud VM and typically completes tasks in 5-60 minutes depending on complexity.

autoApprove.description: Automatically approve the execution plan (default: true). Set false to manually approve with jules_approve_plan

autoCreatePR.description: Automatically create pull request when task completes (default: false)

prompt.description: Detailed task description - be specific about what needs to be done

title.description: Optional custom title for the session

name: jules_create_session
title: Create Jules Coding Session
